name: AEGON LTD.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, share capital / major shareholders disclosure: New York Registry Shares are common shares traded on the NYSE and are exchangeable on a one-to-one basis with the Euronext Amsterdam shares, with the same rights except cash dividends are paid in USD on NYRS; the 20-F cover registers Common shares, par value EUR 0.12 per share, under trading symbol AEG on the NYSE
ads_ratio.reason: DATA_GAP:ads_ratio - AEG is not an ADS program representing multiple ordinary shares: the NYSE security is the common share itself in New York registry form, exchangeable 1-for-1, so per-ordinary-share figures are directly comparable to the traded AEG price with no scaling.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 13 Other operating expenses, Employee expenses table: the Shares component is EUR 59 million for FY2025, with EUR 58 million for FY2024 and EUR 54 million for FY2023 in the same table; the same note describes the share plans (STI/LTI shares, shares as fixed compensation) whose cost this line carries
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 under the engine's tags. The filer's own FY2025 Shares expense in employee expenses fills the gap; the engine applies this single EUR value (FX-converted at each period-end rate) to every missing period, so FY2023/FY2024 are charged EUR 59m instead of their filed EUR 54m/EUR 58m - slightly conservative (higher SBC lowers owner's earnings) and immaterial (about EUR 5m on a ~EUR 400-800m OE base). Declared in EUR, the reporting currency; the engine FX-converts.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 16 Earnings per share: weighted average number of common shares outstanding 1,553 million for FY2025 (1,630 million FY2024, 1,879 million FY2023), and the diluted EPS section states diluted EPS equaled basic EPS for all years disclosed because no long-term incentive plans were considered dilutive
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares - DILUTED shares missing for FY2023-2025; only the WeightedAverageShares count is filed, which the filing's EPS note itself identifies as both the basic and the diluted denominator (basic and diluted EPS are identical in all three years). The engine applies this single FY2025 value to every missing period; for FY2023/FY2024 it uses a smaller denominator than the filer's own counts (1,879m / 1,630m), which raises those years' OE/share - the median year under the override is still computed by the engine and the effect is disclosed in analysis.md. Common shares B (345m weighted, 1/40th financial rights) are excluded from the common-share denominator in the filer's own EPS calculation, consistent with the engine's filed count.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, share capital / major shareholders disclosure: New York Registry Shares are common shares traded on the NYSE and are exchangeable on a one-to-one basis with the Euronext Amsterdam shares, with the same rights except cash dividends are paid in USD on NYRS; the 20-F cover registers Common shares, par value EUR 0.12 per share, under trading symbol AEG on the NYSE) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 13 Other operating expenses, Employee expenses table: the Shares component is EUR 59 million for FY2025, with EUR 58 million for FY2024 and EUR 54 million for FY2023 in the same table; the same note describes the share plans (STI/LTI shares, shares as fixed compensation) whose cost this line carries); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 16 Earnings per share: weighted average number of common shares outstanding 1,553 million for FY2025 (1,630 million FY2024, 1,879 million FY2023), and the diluted EPS section states diluted EPS equaled basic EPS for all years disclosed because no long-term incentive plans were considered dilutive); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.25 vs 3-yr median 0.44 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
